title.english: From Bureaucrat to Villainess: Dad's Been Reincarnated!
title.native: 悪役令嬢転生おじさん

synonyms: The Middle-Aged Man that Reincarnated as a Villainess
Om-om yang Bereinkarnasi Menjadi Putri Jahat
中年大叔轉生反派千金
description: After a traffic accident, 52-year-old civil servant Kenzaburou Tondabayashi awakens to find he's become Grace Auvergne, a duke's daughter, and more importantly the villainess of an otome game. Not wanting to get in the way of the happy endings of the young characters around him, Grace sets out to play the role of the villain, but whether it's due to Kenzaburou's memories of being an affectionate parent getting in the way or not being able to remember those pesky foreign names properly, it ends up being a lot harder than it looks...

name.native: グレイス・オーヴェルヌ

node.description:
The daughter of Duke Auvergne and the villainess in the otome game "Magical Academy: Love & Beast".

In her past life, used to be a 52 years old man called Kenzaburou Tondabayashi, who worked as a civil servant. Thanks to her "old man" wisdom, her "elegance cheat" and her experience as an ex-parent, she gives counsels to many people within the academy.

Anna is the protagonist of the otome game "Magical Academy: Love & Beast." She comes from a commoner family and earned the top score on the Royal Magic Academy's entrance exams. In the original game, she has a terrible relationship with [Grace](https://anilist.co/character/204687/Grace-Auvergne) due to their conflicting personalities, but after Kenzaburou becomes Grace, Anna ends up admiring her.

name.native: ヴィルジール・ヴィエルジ

node.description: Virgile is the first prince of the kingdom and a love interest in the otome game "Magical Academy: Love & Beast." He is [Grace's](https://anilist.co/character/204687/Grace-Auvergne) fiance and the head of the student council. He has both a kind heart which sees everyone equally, and a cold mind which judges others based on their value to the country.

name.native: オーギュスト・リオン

node.description: Auguste is one of the love interests from the otome game "Magical Academy: Love & Beast."  He is a member of the student council and head of security.

name.native: リシャール・ヴェルソー

node.description: Richard is one of the love interests from the otome game "Magical Academy: Love and Beast." He is the vice president of the Royal Academy's student council. He has a reputation for rarely talking, but it is actually because he is restraining himself from telling corny jokes whenever he does speak. He is also known for his skill in fencing, making him one of the best fighters within the student council.

Pierre is a love interest in the otome game "Magical Academy: Love and Beast." He is the secretary of the royal academy's student council and personal attendant to Prince [Virgile.](https://anilist.co/character/349676/Virgile-Vierge) He has an earnest personality and takes great pride in his work

name.native: ランベール・バランス

node.description: Lambert is a love interest in the otome game "Magical Academy: Love and Beast." He does accounting for the royal academy's student council and has a high intelligence. He came from a noble family which fell into ruin, so feels a strong desire to prove himself and sees [Anna](https://anilist.co/character/349675/Anna-Doll) as a rival.

Lucas is a love interest in the otome game "Magical Academy: Love and Beast." He is the younger brother of [Virgile](https://anilist.co/character/349676/Virgile-Vierge) and second prince of the kingdom. He works for the student council and is always smiling, however is also a troublemaker who causes conflicts.

name.native: レオポルド・オーヴェルヌ

node.description: Leopold is [Grace](https://anilist.co/character/204687/Grace-Auvergne)'s father and the Minister of Finance of the kingdom. He was born in the countryside and adopted into the Auvergne family, which caused him to develop a complex which he still has today.

Josette is an apprentice maid of the Auvergne household. She makes many mistakes and was often scolded by [Grace](https://anilist.co/character/204687/Grace-Auvergne) to the point where she was convinced she would be fired if she made another mistake. The shift in Grace's personality made her extremely confused.

name.native: フランセット・メルキュール

node.description: Francette is a 1st year student at the royal academy and member of the drama club. In the original plot of "Magical Academy: Love and Beast", she was a close friend of [Anna](https://anilist.co/character/349675/Anna-Doll) and would provide information to the player. However, her role was made obsolete when Kenzaburo became [Grace](https://anilist.co/character/204687/Grace-Auvergne).
Hinako is [Kenzaburo's](https://anilist.co/character/204687/Grace-Auvergne) daughter. She is an otaku like both of her parents, and enjoys otome games like Magical Academy: Love and Beast.

Mitsuko is [Kenzaburo's](https://anilist.co/character/204687/Grace-Auvergne) wife. She is an extreme otaku like the rest of her family, with a strong interest in isekai stories in her student days, so she is quick to accept her husband's situation.
